info.title: PAIMind Enterprise HaaS
info.description: Contract baseline, not a claim of implemented or accepted routes. Identity is the first vertical slice; runtime routes remain Pending until adapter and Browser E2E receipts exist.

post.description: Explicit same-tenant administrator request for an exact suspended, expired managed binding and current running resource revision. Confirmed reason, stable idempotency key and current login required. Request and audit commit atomically; HTTP never manages containers. The existing lifecycle-owned operator inbox may durably claim once, verifies old writer physically stopped, retains original volumes/image/policy, creates one replacement, reads actual limits and native health, commits exact admission with current authority, obtains its own gateway acknowledgement and records applied. Queued requests lose authority after logout, role/target/tenant/policy changes. Executing or unknown effects are never automatically reclaimed or retried. Historical replay stays queued even if later applied; read receipt and fresh runtime state separately. At most one queued/executing/unconfirmed request per target and 10000 records per tenant. Migration 0015 and explicit minimum application grants required; no automatic migration, second runtime or scheduler. Full browser acceptance Pending.

202.description: Historical queued request with operationId, replayed and requestId; not proof of recovery.

post.description: Explicit confirmed reason, same-tenant administrator and atomic read audit. Returns unresolved request first, otherwise latest terminal receipt, or null. Does not retry or infer current runtime/physical stop. Available when target is disabled or offline.

200.description: Audited historical request or null.

get.description: Audited current same-tenant administrator reads historical metadata only. No native access, execution, private origin, container/volume identity or automatic retry.

200.description: Current recorded outcome; applied is a historical verified replacement, not perpetual health.

post.description: Current same-tenant administrator explicitly confirms a reason. Read policy intent and the latest operator-recorded exact binding observation in the same identity/audit transaction. No container endpoint, volume, transport key or native content is returned. Operator-observed means an unexpired ready lease with matching recorded policy, not a pressure test or proof of physical stop. Missing/expired/mismatched observations remain unconfirmed. Fresh read, not an idempotency replay. No Docker authority or native execution.

200.description: Audited intent and operator observation, never full resource acceptance.

post.description: Persist versioned CPU/memory/process and running/suspended intent within existing deployment capacity. Explicit confirmed reason, same-tenant current admin, optimistic revision and stable idempotency key required. Policy, receipt and audit commit atomically. New policy immediately excludes stale binding observations from all gateway admission reads; existing operator lane withdraws only that cell when its renewal fails. Saving does not apply limits or stop a writer. A running intent never revives old leases or automatically restarts containers; trusted operator must independently verify a new exact container/revision through existing maintenance/recovery ownership. Historical replay is never current enforcement. Persistent storage quotas are not yet enforced and unsupported fields are rejected. Migration 0014 and updated gateway/controller must be deployed as a compatible pair after backup; no implicit online migration.

200.description: Intent and historical command receipt, not applied quota.

post.description: Durable enable/disable intent through the original native Include/Loader and existing current-authority controller. Current same-tenant administrator, active member, full admitted cell, exact configuration version and observed configuration revision required. Enable additionally pins the exact current approved revision and persistent cell/volume/image/policy scope, independently checked at the native write and actual tool use. Disable requires expectedApprovalRevision null and no continuing approval. Native lifecycle preflight before atomic reservation/audit; only one sender. Configuration commands, new approvals and activation commands serialize against either unresolved command. Revocation remains available. Activation reservations are not grants and do not block their own current approval reads; unresolved configuration commands still deny use. At most 10000 activation records per tenant, eight active management requests globally, two per token, 15-second deadline; 16384-byte input limit. Exact native acknowledgement plus fresh matching lifecycle, actor/pin/approval and committed audit required for confirmation. Lost or malformed reply may follow real activation/disable: mark unconfirmed and do not resend, infer success or claim rollback. Same-key replay returns historical receipt only and never reactivates a stopped connector. Native lifecycle remains independently revocable. Final browser acceptance Pending.

Audited same-tenant historical metadata; unconfirmed command takes precedence over latest terminal receipt. Available for disabled/offline members. Does not read native configuration, write, retry, probe a connection or grant use.

200.description: Historical activation receipt or null.

get.description: Current administrator reads an audited same-tenant historical receipt, never an execution grant or a fresh native observation. Unknown/foreign IDs return 404; no native I/O.

post.description: Explicitly end tracking only after trusted deployment stops the old cell and admits a different container/revision with identical persistent cell/member/tenant/role/volume/image/policy. Current administrator confirms the replacement revision and reason. Read native lifecycle and recheck actor/full pin before atomic superseded audit; historical effect remains unknown, no old command is resent. The gateway does not operate containers. Current saved intent and current approval may independently permit cold recovery; this resolution is not a disable, approval, retry or rollback.

Explicit reason and confirmation for a same-tenant active member. Authorization audit commits before private native observation; exact login, role and complete admitted cell pin are rechecked before disclosure and success audit. Original Include owns all configuration. Enabled intent, native dependency gate and provider phase are independent observations, not current database approval, external connection health or execution permission. No secrets, URLs, arguments, environment, headers, persisted version keys or raw errors. No write, probe, restore or approval. Eight concurrent reads globally, two per login token, 15-second deadline; no automatic polling or retries. Existing disabled-only configuration v1 is unchanged and cannot mislabel active intent. Browser acceptance remains Pending.

200.description: Audited point-in-time native lifecycle, not an activation command or grant.

post.description: Fresh same-tenant admin reads one stored exact approval with reason and confirmation. Available when a member is disabled or its worker/configuration is absent. No private I/O; receipt does not assert current native configuration or activation. Unknown/foreign member returns 404. Read and audit commit together. Idempotency-Key correlates this read, not cached observations.

200.description: Audited historical governance only; not native activation or execution authority.

post.description: Persist an explicit revision-checked approval or revocation. Approve requires current same-tenant active member, exact admitted cell revision, no unconfirmed configuration command and original owner's current stable configuration version. Backend derives tenant/member/cell/storage/image/policy scope; client cannot supply or extend it. Private version read occurs outside SQL transaction; exact actor/pin/approval revision revalidated before atomic decision, audit and idempotent receipt commit. Read failures are audited. Legacy unversioned entries need explicit complete replacement. Revocation requires only same-tenant member existence and latest approval revision: no live worker or readable configuration. No native write, activation, tool grant or process-stop claim. Approval remains a historical exact-version record if native state later changes. Replay requires current admin, unchanged decision record and, for approved records, the same admitted persistent scope; no private I/O or current-version inference. Eight in flight globally, two per token, 15-second deadline; at most 10000 stored entries per tenant. Body limit 16384 bytes. Runtime activation and per-use authorization remain separately required; real browser acceptance Pending.

200.description: Audited historical governance only; not native activation or execution authority.

post.description: Current same-tenant administrator reads the most recent redacted connector command, with an unconfirmed command taking precedence. No native access and no credential needed. Enables recovery after a browser loses the whole command response. Offline or disabled members retain historical receipts. Unknown/foreign member returns 404. Audited on every read; Idempotency-Key is correlation only.

200.description: Historical command, not current native settings or authority.

post.description: Save, replace or remove literal disabled configuration through the original native Include owner. Does not approve activation or grant tools. Current administrator, same-tenant active member, exact admitted cell and opaque configuration revision required. Native preparation checks syntax, collisions and bounds before reserving a sole sender with audit. Only redacted intent and server-keyed payload digest persist in PostgreSQL, never configuration or secrets. Replays return historical receipts without I/O, changed payload conflicts. One unresolved command per member; 10000 retained per tenant; eight in flight and two per token per process; 15-second deadline. Exact native acknowledgement, fresh matching state and fresh actor/pin audit required for confirmation. Lost/malformed response remains unconfirmed, never resent or inferred successful. Body limit 16384 bytes. Invalid native preparation currently gives sanitized 502 without reservation. Activation, grants and browser acceptance Pending.

200.description: Historical saved-disabled, unchanged, conflict or superseded receipt; no activation or grant.

202.description: Effect may already have persisted. Do not resend or use another key. Read the receipt/state and perform explicit fenced recovery if required.

get.description: Fresh same-tenant administrator authorization and audit for a redacted historical command. Unknown/foreign command is 404. No native access, secret, private pin or cached execution grant.

200.description: Historical receipt only.

post.description: Explicitly supersede an unconfirmed historical operation; never confirm its unknown effect or resend it. Trusted operator must first stop the old runtime and admit a replacement with identical cell/member/tenant/role/storage/image/policy and distinct container/revision. Current admin confirms the new revision and reason; read original configuration then reauthorize exact pin before terminal audit. The gateway cannot stop/restart containers. New configuration requires a separate explicit command. Same-runtime, wrong revision/storage/image/policy and already terminal commands return conflict. Idempotency-Key is correlation only: a repeat resolution cannot execute another native write.

200.description: Superseded receipt, historical effect explicitly unknown.

post.description: Current admin requests same-tenant active member configuration metadata with reason and confirmation. Original file owner only; no raw configuration or secrets. Audit and exact actor/pin rechecks before and after private I/O. Not activation or tool authorization.

200.description: Disabled configuration metadata and current cell revision.

post.description: Current same-tenant administrator confirms a reason to read one active member's native Loader connector inventory through the exact admitted private cell. Fresh authorization and committed audit precede I/O; login, member and cell are revalidated before disclosure and completion audit. Same idempotency key does not replay observations. Eight in-flight reads per process, two per token, 15-second total and four-second private request limits. Metadata only: no endpoint, command, arguments, environment, headers, credentials, raw errors or configuration hash. Activation is not connection health, authorization or a tool call. Missing owners, invalid/oversized output and audit failure deny disclosure. No configuration write, grant or native public RPC is exposed.

200.description: Fresh redacted observation with committed access disclosure, not complete connector management.

post.description: Explicit audited read of an active same-tenant member's exact admitted native runtime. Reports original default selection, providers/catalog, credential presence and exact credential/settings writability plus cell/settings revisions. No credential values, endpoints or raw provider errors; no authorization, quota, credential-validity or model-call claim. Revalidate the same admin/session/target/cell around native reads and reject settings revision changes. Idempotency-Key is correlation only: reads are fresh, never cached command replays. Full native-browser configuration/use acceptance remains Pending.

200.description: Read-only native observation with committed access disclosure.

post.description: Read only the original enterprise instruction namespace for one current same-tenant active member. Reason/confirmation, exact managed cell and fresh current administrator authorization are required before native access and before release. The authorization and completed read are audited. Never expose unrelated settings, schema, base/user layers, secrets or private origin. Eight in flight and two per login token per service process, 15 second deadline; no polling or permission grant.

200.description: Fresh native snapshot and committed read audit.

post.description: Replace only enabled and instructions in the native enterprise namespace via native CAS. Administrator, same-tenant active member, exact managed cell revision, native settings revision and explicit reason/confirmation are mandatory. A short audit transaction reserves exactly one sender before native I/O. The journal stores intent metadata and server-keyed input digest, never instruction text. One unconfirmed operation per member; 10000 retained commands per tenant; eight in flight and two per login token. At most 65536 request bytes and 8000 instruction characters. Same actor/key/input replays only the historical receipt; changed input conflicts. Success requires exact native ack, fresh owner readback, current actor/pin and confirmation audit. Lost/malformed/post-persistence errors remain unconfirmed; no automatic retry. Does not change models, tools, Agent persona or authorization.

200.description: Terminal historical receipt; inspect outcome.

202.description: Effect unknown; read receipt/state, do not resend or change key.

post.description: Audited current administrator read of the most recent member instruction command, preferring unconfirmed. Works for offline or disabled same-tenant members. No native I/O or instruction content. Enables recovery when the browser lost the complete command response. Idempotency key is correlation only.

200.description: Historical receipt, not present configuration.

get.description: Current same-tenant administrator and read audit required; unknown/foreign ids are 404. No native access, private pin, instruction contents or cached grant.

200.description: Redacted historical receipt.

post.description: Only supersede an unconfirmed historical command after a trusted operator physically stops the old writer and admits a replacement with identical member/tenant/cell/role/volume/image/policy but different container and revision. Current administrator confirms new revision and reason; native read and fresh authority/pin precede audit. Effect remains unknown, no instruction resend, no automatic restart. A new desired configuration requires a separate explicit command. Repeat/old/same-cell-incarnation resolution conflicts.

200.description: Superseded; historical effect explicitly unknown.

post.description: Current same-tenant administrator reads the most recent redacted model command, with an unconfirmed command taking precedence. No native access and no credential needed. Enables recovery after a browser loses the whole command response. Offline or disabled members retain historical receipts. Unknown/foreign member returns 404. Audited on every read; Idempotency-Key is correlation only.

200.description: Historical command, not current native settings or authority.

post.description: Configure the original native default model or its exact owner-resolved named credential. Requires current admin, active same-tenant member, exact admitted cell revision and settings revision. Validate original providers/catalog or credential writability. Atomically reserve one sender with audit before native I/O outside SQL transactions; secret inputs persist only as a server-keyed HMAC, never plaintext/carrier. Same actor/key/input only returns the durable receipt, including after restart; different input conflicts. One unconfirmed command per member, 10000 retained per tenant, eight in-flight operations and two per login token per service process, 15-second deadline. Success requires exact native acknowledgement, fresh original-owner readback and fresh authority/pin before confirmation audit. Precise CAS conflict is a terminal no-effect receipt. Lost/malformed/post-persistence error remains unconfirmed; no auto-retry. Native settings revisions are process-local, hence the mandatory cell revision. Credentials have no native CAS/journal. No model call or credential-validity claim; native settings/credentials remain sole owners.

200.description: Terminal historical receipt (applied, conflict, or replay of superseded); inspect outcome, not HTTP status alone.

202.description: Effect may already have persisted. Do not resend or use another key. Read the receipt/state and perform explicit fenced recovery if required.

get.description: Fresh same-tenant administrator authorization and audit for a redacted historical command. Unknown/foreign command is 404. No native access, secret, private pin or cached execution grant.

200.description: Historical receipt only.

post.description: Explicitly supersede an unconfirmed historical operation; never confirm its unknown effect or resend it. Trusted operator must first stop the old runtime and admit a replacement with identical cell/member/tenant/role/storage/image/policy and distinct container/revision. Current admin confirms the new revision and reason; read original settings then reauthorize exact pin before terminal audit. The gateway cannot stop/restart containers. New configuration requires a separate explicit command. Same-runtime, wrong revision/storage/image/policy and already terminal commands return conflict. Idempotency-Key is correlation only: a repeat resolution cannot execute another native write.

200.description: Superseded receipt, historical effect explicitly unknown.

post.description: Fresh bounded original-owner state and latest durable command read for an active same-tenant target on its exact operator-pinned accepted runtime. No native mutation, auto-retry or auto-confirmation. Revalidate current admin and complete target pin after the native read, then commit read audit. Native execution journal phase and database confirmation remain distinct; pending commands take precedence over latest history. No private address/login/transport material exposed. observedAt is a read timestamp, not a live subscription. Idempotency-Key is correlation only.

200.description: Original native view plus current governance and historical command metadata.

post.description: Read the original native owner plan for an active same-tenant account on its exact operator-pinned managed runtime and accepted image/catalog. No settings mutation. Response exposes dependency/rollback reconciliation scope, current approval and operator ceiling, but not private addresses or login identity. Revalidate current admin and exact binding after the read; 15-second signal and at most eight in-flight service operations. Idempotency-Key is correlation only for this fresh read.

200.description: Current authorized read or committed governance receipt; never a runtime execution grant.

post.description: Explicit revision-checked approval within the operator accepted image/catalog/pack ceiling. Approval alone never enables, installs or disables anything. Commit exact scope and audit atomically. Replaying an old key requires current target image and approval revision; a changed scope requires a new explicit command.

200.description: Current authorized read or committed governance receipt; never a runtime execution grant.

post.description: Re-preview exact original native plan. Current approval must cover all reconciled packs including dependencies and rollback. Persist immutable command identity, actor, exact target pin and plan plus audit before private native effects. At most one unconfirmed command per account and 10000 retained commands per tenant. Replay the same actor/key and input only. Native effect and database confirmation are not a distributed atomic transaction: current identity, approval and pin must still match before receipt/audit confirmation. Native Settings and Loader remain original owners. UI, native management bypass closure, accepted final images and browser acceptance remain Pending.

200.description: Current authorized read or committed governance receipt; never a runtime execution grant.

202.description: Original command remains unconfirmed. It may already have been accepted. Retain the original command ID and input; do not treat as success or rollback.

get.description: Current same-tenant admin reads an immutable historical receipt, not live effective state or current authority. No native access or replay; unknown/foreign command is 404. Read is audited.

200.description: Historical command summary; not an execution grant.

post.description: Explicit audited recovery of the immutable original pending command under the current admin and complete current approval. Legacy same-runtime input remains supported. expectedRuntimeDigest, when supplied, must match the freshly read complete current runtime identity. A replacement requires allowReplacement:true and that digest, the same cell/member/tenant/role/data-volume/image/policy, a new container and revision, and a complete matching original native command journal read before apply; revalidate current authority and binding again before replay and confirmation. Operator admission and old-writer termination remain independent deployment responsibilities. Ordinary create retries never migrate to replacement runtimes. Original input and target pin remain immutable. Historical terminal commands return a receipt without native effects. Idempotency-Key is correlation only; commandId identifies the effect. Real final-container/browser recovery remains Pending.

200.description: Current authorized read or committed governance receipt; never a runtime execution grant.

202.description: Original command remains unconfirmed. It may already have been accepted. Retain the original command ID and input; do not treat as success or rollback.

post.description: Fresh audited readonly access to a same-tenant member's original native session list or backward history page. Reason and explicit confirmation are required even for list metadata. Authorization audit commits before native access; original admin login and exact operator-pinned private binding are revalidated before returning data. No member login, execution, edit, arbitrary path/method or transcript store. A disabled member may be inspected only while its existing pinned private runtime remains safely readable; no automatic startup. At most two reads per login and eight per service, 15-second cancellation signal, 8-second native inactivity timeout, 2 MiB native-response cap. List overflow above 500 is rejected; history asks the original owner for at most 20 messages and exposes visible text only, with other blocks explicitly omitted. Every retry/page reauthorizes and audits; no cached content replay.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required UUID transport correlation only for this audited read. Unlike mutation commands, reuse neither returns cached content nor skips a fresh authorization/access record.

200.description: Bounded original-owner page and readonly access disclosure, not proof the administrator read all content.

get.description: Read a page of the same-tenant immutable review archive, not the current editable source. Reauthorize current login and exact revision/archive before database chunks and final response. No filesystem extraction, installation or execution. At most 100 entries per page; all entries, including directories and empty files, remain addressable. Unsupported or malformed source-export formats fail closed. No query parameters or writes.

Read up to 32768 exact inert file bytes, encoded as canonical base64. Entry ordinal is from this exact archive, never a filesystem path. Offset is byte based and aligned; an empty file allows offset 0 and returns empty data. Current login and exact revision are checked again before final return. Browser renders plain text or hexadecimal, never HTML/scripts. No full-file memory load, download side effect, extraction or native mutation.

Same bounded sealed archive index as review, but requires a currently published version and current explicit assignment. Authors/admins need assignment too. Current user deny wins over allow; archive is not a permission cache. Unknown, foreign, withdrawn or unassigned publication returns 404. Revision mismatch returns 409. Every database read and final response reauthorizes; no fallback to review-copy.

Same inert 32768-byte read as review, requiring current explicit published assignment on every read and final response. Complete binary files can be traversed without truncation; empty files remain visible. At most two concurrent content reads per account and eight per service; a request has a 30-second deadline. No automatic installation, enabling or execution grant.

post.description: Adopt the complete sealed archive through the authenticated member's fixed private native cell. Administrators and authors also need current explicit assignment. Recheck current login, publication revision and assignment before each bounded chunk and final receipt/audit commit. Same-key replay verifies current target bytes and provenance, without copying or repairing. Same-name personal or other published versions fail closed. A failed or disconnected request may follow completed native writes; retain the original key and historical files. Adoption never enables a Skill or grants model/tool execution. Existing native Skill eligibility remains closed until current runtime authorization is connected.

200.description: Verified complete native immutable version and committed or revalidated command receipt. Not an execution grant.

get.description: Admin review metadata; source creation and exact archive ownership remain separate.

200.description: Current metadata only; no archive download, native installation or runtime grant.

post.description: Capture exact own saved Skill through the fixed private cell; preserve full immutable archive in bounded PG chunks. Transfer outside tenant transaction, reauthorize and atomically commit receipt/audit. 1000 candidates, 2 GiB per tenant, 200 MiB expanded/216 MiB archive. Same-request explicit retry fences expired staging; sealed bytes survive source edits and uncertain commit. No body bytes, identity, paths or target origin accepted.

201.description: Current metadata only; no archive download, native installation or runtime grant.

get.description: Same-tenant review metadata, not assigned use or full content preview.

200.description: Current metadata only; no archive download, native installation or runtime grant.

post.description: Pending to publish/reject, published to withdraw; current revision and atomic success audit. Does not enable Agent dependency execution.

200.description: Current metadata only; no archive download, native installation or runtime grant.

get.description: Current same-tenant rules, including inactive rules.

200.description: Current metadata only; no archive download, native installation or runtime grant.

post.description: User/active-group/all allow, explicit user deny first; atomic revision and audit. No native installation.

200.description: Current metadata only; no archive download, native installation or runtime grant.

get.description: Only currently assigned published metadata. Author and administrator are not automatically assigned.

200.description: Current metadata only; no archive download, native installation or runtime grant.

get.description: Recheck current identity and effective assignment, deny unavailable/foreign known IDs. Not a cached runtime permission.

200.description: Current metadata only; no archive download, native installation or runtime grant.

post.description: Explicitly prepares the current assigned immutable version in the authenticated member's managed native cell. Administrators and authors also need assignment. No submitted content, identity or destination. Same-key replay reauthorizes and reads the current native receipt without adopting or repairing it. A 503 may follow completed native file writes; retain the original key and resources. Database receipt/audit and native files are not a distributed atomic transaction. The result is not runtime permission; per-step model/tool authorization and Browser E2E remain required.

200.description: Current native adoption confirmed and original command receipt committed or revalidated; never an execution grant.

get.description: Current author's immutable submissions only.

post.description: Exact saved Agent revision is read from the server-bound caller's native cell. No submitted snapshot or identity accepted. Creates pending review, not publishing authority. Missing or changed source fails closed.

get.description: Same-tenant admin review inventory.
Reauthorizes identity and current user deny > user allow > active-group allow > all allow > default deny. Authorship or admin role alone does not add catalog entries.

Reauthorizes the current login, published state and explicit assignment in one tenant-ordered transaction, then returns exact immutable content. Authors and administrators need explicit assignment too; never returns review-copy. Unknown, foreign, withdrawn and unassigned IDs return 404. This read is not cached authority for adoption or execution.
Owner/admin may read review content; others need a published assignment. Unknown and foreign IDs return the same 404.

post.description: Pending to publish/reject, published to withdraw. Exact revision and reason required. Publishing an Agent with Business Skill dependencies requires an explicit published Skill id for each exact name and package digest. Immutable dependency edges, review state, audit and replay receipt commit atomically. Agent assignment does not grant Skill assignment or installation; adoption and execution independently require current access to every fixed Skill version.

get.description: Exact same-tenant publication and current rule revision.

post.description: User, active-group or all allow; deny only for a specific user. All input omits subjectId. Exact revision, active identity, tenant scope and atomic audit required.

patch.description: Changes only a member display name. Identity, login username, roles, status and existing resources are preserved. A stale expectedDisplayName returns 409. Mutation, replay receipt and before/after audit are atomic.

get.description: Complete tenant-scoped groups including archived groups, at most 200 groups and 500 member references per group. Capacity overflow fails; never silently truncate. Group membership does not itself grant resources or change account roles.

post.description: Creates an empty active group with revision 1. Names normalize to NFC and are case-insensitively unique within the tenant, including archived groups. Mutation, receipt and audit commit together.

patch.description: Atomically replaces an active group's name and complete membership, increments revision and audits exact added/removed IDs. All IDs must refer to accounts in this tenant; disabled accounts retain identity but remain unable to log in. Canonical IDs are deduplicated by rejection and sorted before idempotency comparison. Revision mismatch or archived group returns 409; unknown or foreign IDs return the same 404. No role, runtime or resource permission is changed.

Archive or restore with a reason and expected revision. Preserves group identity, name, memberships, accounts and native resources. Exact replay reauthorizes then returns its original receipt without reapplying; stale new commands or unchanged status return 409.

get.description: Owner-only live projection from the authenticated account's currently admitted native cell. Administrators use their own cell; inspecting another member still requires the separate reason-gated audited route. At most 500 complete native entries; overflow or malformed native content fails closed, never silently truncates. No query parameters, copied history or enterprise session registry. Logout, binding change, gateway shutdown and disconnected caller cancel the read. Existing cookie authentication and request-origin boundaries apply to independent clients as well.

post.x-delivery-state: Durable creation and operator-linked replacement recovery implemented; final acceptance Pending
post.description: Creates in the caller's currently admitted private native cell and existing native workspace, using an explicitly assigned publication already adopted through the existing catalog/adoption contract. releaseId is the existing publicationId, agentId is that immutable publication's source agentId, and configVersion is its source configuration version, not the adopted local preset version. Administrators and authors also require current assignment. No implicit adoption, new workspace, model message or second session history is created. A durable command reservation fixes one server-generated native session ID and preserves its original runtime target. Same-key concurrent requests share that identity; different canonical input returns 409. Replay reauthorizes current login, release and cell, then first reads the original native session/preset/workspace owners. If an unconfirmed reservation is absent or only partially created, one explicit same-key request may recover through native fixed-ID ensureSession and idempotent workspace attachment; in-process attempts coalesce and the original native owner deduplicates independent callers. This does not generalize to prompts or arbitrary native writes. A conflicting existing preset returns 409. A historically confirmed command NEVER creates or resumes again, including cold history after replacement. Current complete proof returns 201 even on replay; an unknown effect returns 202 and never authorizes a new key or a background retry loop. A receipt is neither current authority nor proof of existence. Changed bindings require a complete immutable operator-owned replacement chain, matching tenant/user/role/cell, original data volume, image and policy at every hop, plus current exact admission. The deployment owner records edges only after stopping/joining the old writer and verifying exclusive owned storage/new cell. The command's original target is not rewritten. Missing/foreign/cyclic/incompatible history or more than 32 hops returns 409; prior replacements without retained evidence are not backfilled. No browser-supplied revision/URL/volume can authorize recovery, and this endpoint never restarts a cell. Deployment lineage capacity is 10000 retained edges per tenant; admission and edge recording commit together. At 10000 retained creation commands per tenant, new reservations return 409. Existing cookie, same-origin JSON, request-size, timeout and disconnect boundaries apply. Disconnect does not prove rollback.

201.description: Current native owners confirm the exact session, preset and workspace relation. Receipt does not grant execution.

202.description: Current effect unconfirmed. Preserve the command and native IDs. An explicit same-key request reauthorizes, reads back and may recover only a never-confirmed command via the native fixed-ID creation contract. No new key, blind write retry or background polling; previously confirmed commands remain read-only.

/haas/v1/sessions/{sessionId}.x-history-version: The exact current native event/preset checksum is returned as data.version. Before/after reads must agree on checksum and admitted cell; concurrent change returns 409 instead of a mixed snapshot. Full original event projection is bounded to 10000 events and 2 MiB; overflow fails, never truncates a version. This checksum is concurrency control, not authorization.

get.description: Read-only visible-text history projection from the exact native session owner. Native history queries request at most 20 messages, preserve original event sequence numbers, and return nextBeforeSeq for older pages; this is not a complete event stream or an approval/file/artifact substitute. Non-text blocks are counted as omittedBlocks, never fabricated. An existing session in another user's cell is indistinguishable from an unknown ID (403 native-session-denied). No create/resume operation or persistent history copy. Current identity and cell binding are rechecked before returning content. Encoded slashes, backslashes, control characters, invalid encoding and unknown/duplicate query parameters are rejected. Bounded native reads fail safely with 502 native-unavailable; caller disconnect cancels upstream work.

parameters.name: beforeSeq
parameters.description: Positive original native sequence number, exclusive upper boundary; omit for the most recent page.

post.x-delivery-state: Live/cold-session submission, persisted receipt recovery and pending-queue continuation implemented; final acceptance Pending
post.description: Submit exact untrimmed text through the original native prompt queue with current login, owned session, exact private cell and current publication/dependency eligibility. The prior GET data.version is required. Original native admission checks the version again synchronously at inbox insertion after asynchronous preparation. A tenant/user-scoped UUID idempotency key fixes one command UUID, input HMAC, expected version, content digest and original target; command/audit tables never contain message bodies or a second transcript. Different input with the same key or stale version returns 409. Replays reauthorize, including immutable operator replacement lineage when the cell changes. Original persisted insertion identity, not a live-only event or model reply, proves admission. An unconfirmed command with verified persisted insertion can be confirmed readonly when the original message is no longer pending, without resuming a cold session or invoking a model.
